title: Are the two Clarks one man?
what_we_know: A print is labeled CLARK & BARNS, NAV & BOMB. The Tampa order lists crew 1481, Clark, after this crew.
what_we_dont: Whether they are the same man, and his full name.
what_might_answer_it: The full Tampa order page; the print's source.
evidence_needed: A paper naming Clark in full with his position.
